night2_start.name: {name}
night2_start.text: *Back home. Showered, lying in bed — when — messenger notifications start pouring in. Three people. At the same time.*

night2_msg_seo_specific.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_specific.text: Thanks for today. Got done early because of you

night2_msg_seo_specific_2.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_specific_2.text: I might draft you again next time. Brace yourself.

night2_msg_seo_general.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_general.text: I'll leave the rooftop open at lunch tomorrow. Come

night2_msg_dain_general.name: Dain
night2_msg_dain_general.text: Yo, snack bar tomorrow! Still salty we skipped it today!

night2_msg_dain_general_merge.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_dain_general_merge.text: Roof at lunch tomorrow? Should be a nice breeze.

night2_msg_seo_general_alt.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_seo_general_alt.text: I'll leave the rooftop open tomorrow. Come if you have time

night2_msg_yuna_general.name: Yuna
night2_msg_yuna_general.text: ...are you coming to the annex tomorrow?

night2_msg_generic_2.name: Seoyeon
night2_msg_generic_2.text: I'll leave the rooftop open at lunch tomorrow

night2_msg_7.name: {name}
night2_msg_7.text: *Three people waiting for a reply. — Is this a blessing or a curse?*

night2_reply_dain_4.name: Dain
night2_reply_dain_4.text: nah wait mild tteokbokki doesn't count lol

night2_reply_seo_1.name: {name}
night2_reply_seo_1.text: Call me and I'll be there

night2_reply_seo_3.name: {name}
night2_reply_seo_3.text: It's an easy one to keep.

night2_reply_seo_4.name: Seoyeon
night2_reply_seo_4.text: I'll leave the roof open at lunch. Actually show up this time.

night2_reply_seo_5.name: {name}
night2_reply_seo_5.text: *'Actually show up this time.' The words say invitation — sounds like a warning.*

night2_reply_yuna_5.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_5.text: *The third star? — I glance toward the window. The sky's full of them. No idea which one she means.*

night2_reply_yuna_7.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_7.text: *I'll count them tomorrow night. — Because of her, I keep catching myself looking up.*

night2_end_1.name: {name}
night2_end_1.text: *I sent my replies and set the phone down. Day two is over.*

night2_end_2.name: {name}
night2_end_2.text: *Day two, done. Yesterday it was curiosity — I wondered who they were. Tonight, it's different. Not curious. They're just stuck in my head. What they're doing right now. What they'll say tomorrow.*

night2_flashback_1.name: {name}
night2_flashback_1.text: *Minsu's words keep coming back. 'Were you like this at your old school too?'*

night2_flashback_2.name: {name}
night2_flashback_2.text: *I scrolled way back. Three months ago. — A photo. A group shot from the school trip. Sojeong is smiling. Right next to me. — The week after this photo was when the graffiti started appearing on Sojeong's desk. I liked her. No question. But there was something more urgent than saying 'I like you.'*

night2_flashback_3.name: {name}
night2_flashback_3.text: *Every night back then, I'd open my phone. Type something in the notes app, then delete it. Love confessions, but also things like 'Teacher, Sojeong is being —'. Every single time, I stopped just before sending. If I spoke up, I'd become a target too. Then one day in March, Sojeong's seat was empty. The next day too. And the day after that.*

night2_flashback_5.name: {name}
night2_flashback_5.text: *The drafts in my notes app stop at number 38. There's no 39. Because there was nobody left to send it to. I never confessed, and I never stood up for her. The transfer wasn't because of Sojeong — it was my dad's job. But I didn't mind leaving. At least I wouldn't have to pass by Sojeong's empty desk every day.*

night2_flashback_7.name: {name}
night2_flashback_7.text: *'This time, don't look away.' — That was the promise I made coming to this school. I closed the gallery. Thought about deleting the photo, but — left it. If I deleted it, I was afraid I'd forget the guilt along with it.*

night2_flashback_8.name: {name}
night2_flashback_8.text: *But — I stare at the ceiling. Today won't quiet down. Seoyeon. Dain. Yuna. All three are stuck in my head. I could call it curiosity. Honestly though, it scares me. The thought of leaning toward any one of them.*

night2_flashback_9.name: {name}
night2_flashback_9.text: *Back with Sojeong, I only looked at one person. I only liked one person, only watched one person — and even as she fell apart right beside me, I stopped at the notes app. Thirty-eight times. When you only look at one person, losing them means losing everything. I didn't know that then.*

night2_flashback_10.name: {name}
night2_flashback_10.text: *— That's why I'm keeping the door open with all three of them. I don't want to admit it. If I choose too fast, I'll only see her — the rest will blur out, and the next time someone falls apart, I won't notice until it's too late. It's a safety net. I know it's cowardly. Anyone watching would just call me indecisive. But I know what it's like to lose someone because they were the only one you were looking at. That terrifies me more than anything.*

night2_hidden_check.name: {name}
night2_hidden_check.text: *Between the messenger alerts — I spot more notifications.*

night2_hidden_homeroom_1.name: {name}
night2_hidden_homeroom_1.text: *A private message from the homeroom teacher. '{name}, thanks for coming to the office today. The paperwork's done so I won't need to call you in again. ...But if settling in gets tough, come by anytime.'*

night2_hidden_homeroom_2.name: {name}
night2_hidden_homeroom_2.text: *Three lines. Gratitude, distance, then reaching back out. — She's having a tug of war with herself.*

night2_hidden_homeroom_3.name: {name}
night2_hidden_homeroom_3.text: *'Won't need to call you in' and 'come by anytime' in the same message. Contradictory — but that's so her.*

night2_hidden_nurse_1.name: {name}
night2_hidden_nurse_1.text: *Health app notification. 'Nurse's Record: {name} — Elbow abrasion (minor). Note: I'll change the bandage tomorrow morning. Changing bandages is a medical procedure so you can't refuse ^^'*

night2_hidden_nurse_2.name: {name}
night2_hidden_nurse_2.text: *Can't refuse. — Am I going to have to admit that I'm being pulled in?*

night2_reply_dain_react_high.name: Dain
night2_reply_dain_react_high.text: HAHAHA!!!!! I'm literally DYING rn LOL!! You HAVE to come to the gym tomorrow!!

night2_reply_seo_react_high.name: Seoyeon
night2_reply_seo_react_high.text: ...You're more interesting than I expected. Roof for lunch tomorrow?

night2_reply_seo_react_default.name: Seoyeon
night2_reply_seo_react_default.text: Hm. Got it. See you tomorrow.

night2_reply_yuna_react_high.name: Yuna
night2_reply_yuna_react_high.text: ...So someone actually texts back this late. Library tomorrow?

night2_reply_yuna_6_b.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_6_b.text: *I open the window. Cold air rushes in. — There are plenty of stars, but I have no idea which one is the third.*

night2_reply_yuna_6_c.name: {name}
night2_reply_yuna_6_c.text: *A very Yuna riddle. A person who never gives you the answer. — A person who makes you want to find out.*

night2_end_2_b.name: {name}
night2_end_2_b.text: *Those words keep echoing. I still haven't answered. Yesterday they were just on my mind. Today — 'I want to see them' rose to my lips and fell back down.*

night2_end_3_b.name: {name}
night2_end_3_b.text: *The problem is that distance is closing faster than I expected. I close my eyes. — Tomorrow I might have to be a little more honest.*

night2_end_4_b.name: {name}
night2_end_4_b.text: *I open the fridge. Not much there. Leftover rice, eggs, seaweed. — I find myself wanting to pack something to bring tomorrow. For who? I'm not sure. I just want to.*

night2_end_4_c.name: {name}
night2_end_4_c.text: *I threw together a lunch box. It's nothing special. Too sloppy to call it homemade with pride. — But it beats showing up empty-handed.*
